snippet.title: The World Well: Blood of Caro (Launch Trailer)
snippet.description:
The World Well: Blood of Caro launches on Steam on August 18, 2026.

Enter a story-rich dark fantasy visual novel where vampires rule the world and the mysterious Caro are hunted for their blood.

Follow 4, a survivor haunted by her past, and Noma, a resistance mage, as they journey across kingdoms torn apart by war. Uncover forgotten secrets, forge unlikely alliances, and make choices that reveal the truth behind a world built on centuries of lies.  

Available NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648900/The_World_Well_Blood_of_Caro/

Follow The World Well: Blood of Caro on Social Media
X: https://x.com/BloodOfCaro_EN
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61582157108895
